011import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageData;
012import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.io.message.MessageHandler;
013import revxrsal.commands.bukkit.actor.BukkitCommandActor;
014
015/**
016 * Paper-native command source that sends Adventure components directly to Paper's audience.
017 *
018 * <p>The TNPC Paper command source creates and immediately closes a legacy Bukkit audience for
019 * every message. That adapter no longer reliably delivers command replies on Paper 26.2.</p>
020 */
021public class PaperCMDSource extends net.tnemc.plugincore.paper.impl.PaperCMDSource {
022
023  public PaperCMDSource(final BukkitCommandActor actor) {
024
025    super(actor);
026  }
027
028  @Override
029  public void message(final MessageData data) {
030
031    MessageHandler.translate(data, identifier().orElse(null), actor.sender());
032  }
033}
